title: furqan-lint vs. bandit: A Finding-Count Comparison Across 25 Python Codebases
description: Empirical benchmark of furqan-lint v2.1.0, a multi-language static analysis tool checking for structural honesty (surface-substrate divergence), against bandit 1.9.4 across 25 widely-used open-source Python packages (2.3M lines, 5,252 files). Includes raw JSON output from both tools, benchmark harness with offline replay, 208 tests, and a machine-readable rule manifest covering 50 rules across six languages (Python, C, C++, Java, C#, Ada/SPARK).
notes: Benchmark dataset includes per-package raw JSON from furqan-lint and bandit, a versions.json manifest, and a harness with --from-json offline replay. All numbers independently verified by a fresh non-Anthropic audit seat (PASS WITH REVISIONS). Tag v2.1.0 at commit 979c79e.
